body.name: Rational NONID certificate encoding
body.construction: For each returned model \(M_j\), serialize every primitive latent-root mass \(\lambda^{(j)}_{u,r}=P_{M_j}(u=r)\) and every primitive observed-node table entry \(\theta^{(j)}_{i,b\mid a}=P_{M_j}(i=b\mid\operatorname{pa}_G(i)=a)\) as its own coprime pair of nonnegative integers \((p,d)\) with \(d\ge 1\); no common denominator is required. The sum of the numerator and denominator binary lengths of every pair is at most \(B_{\mathrm{rat}}(L)\), and every latent-root alphabet has size at most \(H(L)\). Each induced observed or interventional cell is encoded by its exact finite sum-product circuit over these pairs together with its reduced output pair. Writing \(K_V=\prod_{i\in V}|\Omega_i|\), every reduced cell pair has binary length at most \(H(L)^{|U|}((|V|+|U|)B_{\mathrm{rat}}(L)+|U|\lceil\log_2 H(L)\rceil+1)\), and the complete two-model certificate has serialized bit length at most \(8(L+1)K_VH(L)^{2|U|}(B_{\mathrm{rat}}(L)+\lceil\log_2 H(L)\rceil+L+1)\).
